About Theinstaller

A Winnipeg installation company for commercial glazing and doors.

Theinstaller does one thing: installation. Curtain wall, storefront, office partitions, windows and doors — set properly, sealed properly and finished on time.

We work for general contractors, for suppliers who need a crew, and directly for building owners. Small tenant fit-up or a full building envelope package, the work gets the same attention.

What you can expect

  • A written quote with a clear scope
  • Work done to the shop drawings and manufacturer instructions
  • A clean, safe site
  • Straight answers about schedule and problems
